notes.after: Gath, Don't weep at all. At Beth Ophrah
notes.text: Beth Ophrah means literally "House of Dust."

notes.after: e house of the wicked, And a short ephah
notes.text: An ephah is a measure of volume, and a short ephah is made smaller than a full ephah for the purpose of cheating customers.
